title: Best Market Research Experts (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire a market research expert: surveys, competitor analysis and market sizing, what to include, how to brief it, price factors and red flags.
intro: Market research helps you understand customers, competitors and demand before you invest. Experts run surveys, analyze competitors, estimate market size and summarize trends. Research goes wrong when the question is vague, sources are unreliable or copied, or survey results come from the wrong people. This guide helps you get research you can base decisions on.

faq.q: What kinds of market research can I order?
faq.a: Desk research from existing sources, competitor analysis, customer surveys, interviews, market sizing and trend reports.

faq.q: How do I know the sources are reliable?
faq.a: Ask for every source to be cited, with dates. Prefer official statistics, reputable reports and primary research over unsourced blog posts.

faq.q: Can the expert find survey respondents?
faq.a: Some can, through panels or outreach. Ask how respondents are chosen and whether they match your target customers.
Usually a report or presentation with findings, data, charts and recommendations. Ask for the raw data too.
Some researchers use AI tools to summarize sources. Ask how facts are checked, since AI summaries can contain errors.
